not_full_original_schema: This is a minimal public projection for reproducing administrative counts, not a claim to satisfy the full original annotation schema.
rules: Keys, recorded mechanism codes, dimension subcodes, gate findings, scope limitations and provenance qualifiers copied without new scientific assignment. Full retained evidence is included only for existing DOCUMENTED_INCOMPATIBILITY codes.
position_statuses: Effective status comes from the separately versioned current input and unchanged documentary classifier; historical annotation status is retained as provenance only.
frequency_permissions: All original annotations prohibit corpus-frequency inference; the public projection preserves those false flags.
excluded: No reviewer names, private returns or private filesystem paths are introduced by this projection.
